metadata.vote_status_note: O arquivo de votação por seção não certifica sozinho a situação jurídica dos votos; os denominadores devem ser reconciliados com os totais oficiais.

Annulled extension restricted to Senate; pending category blocked; separate category independently audited; no allocation; Explicit party-zone legend/conversion aggregates counted once per transit partition; coalition descriptor repeats must agree; original nominal rows retained separately; Observed section97 exactly matches the official separately counted annulled category in every zone; excluded separately, NEVER added to nulls; pending category remains blocked; Disputes isolated by ordinary election ID, round and office; blocked disputes explicitly unavailable
